newsitem.title: CHINA: Price Waterhouse gains China member firm licence.
newsitem.headline: Price Waterhouse gains China member firm licence.

text.p: Price Waterhouse said on Monday it had received a licence for a member firm in Beijing, making it the first of the big six international accounting firms to gain such formal approval.

The international accounting firm, which has operated with a representative office in Beijing, said the licence from the Ministry of Finance would allow it to provide auditing as well as consulting services.
Price Waterhouse had said previously it planned to admit a member firm formed by Chinese nationals associated with it.

Price Waterhouse, which employs some 600 staff and partners in its China operations, already has a joint venture in Shanghai as well as representative offices in Guangzhou and Shenzhen in southern China.
In the past, many foreign accounting firms had formed joint ventures with state-run accountants that have been closely linked to local government interests.
China has ordered the disbanding of accounting joint ventures over the next five years as part of a drive to make its accounting sector more independent.
